# Voca

> Open-source desktop app that transcribes your voice with AI corrections and translates into 100+ languages.

Voca is a cross-platform desktop application for macOS and Windows. Press a global keyboard shortcut, speak, and the AI-corrected transcript is automatically pasted where your cursor was. It uses Deepgram Nova-3 and Groq Whisper for speech recognition (35+ languages) and xAI Grok for translation (100+ languages). New accounts get the first month free - $3 in credits, no credit card required. Paid plans start at $3/month.

Full details: [llms-full.txt](https://usevoca.dev/llms-full.txt)
